title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.

title: Bhagya Debata
desc: Jagadish Mondal, an honest commoner, fights against the unjust practices, corruption and crime prevalent in society in a bid to help the poor and needy, while also taking care of his family.

title: Simul Parul
desc: Simul, Rajani's son, falls in love with Parul. However, Parul's father disapproves of their relationship because of his complicated history with Rajani.

title: Swapno
desc: A woman leaves a kind-hearted man owing to a misunderstanding and marries his younger brother. However, it turns out that he is the complete opposite of his elder brother.

title: Anutap
desc: A singer falls in love with a village beauty, and soon they get married. However, their marital bliss is dampened when they are separated due to an unfortunate event.
